question: Should OpenClaw accept this ACP-specific gateway-owned node runtime and command surface now, or pause it in favor of a generic long-running node-command architecture first?
rationale: The PR changes durable runtime storage and the gateway-node trust boundary; automation can point to concrete blockers, but maintainers must choose the product and security architecture before this shape can land.

options.title: Pause until blockers and proof are resolved
options.body: Require SQLite storage, delivery/reconnect/projection/idempotency fixes, conflict resolution, and real paired-node proof before reconsidering the branch.

options.title: Sponsor the ACP-specific runtime shape
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the ACP-specific command surface, then still require the concrete P1 fixes and upgrade/security proof before merge.

options.title: Supersede with a generic node-command path
options.body: Close or replace this branch if the intended direction is the broader streaming node-command primitive tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/74845.

recommendation.title: Pause until blockers and proof are resolved
recommendation.body: Require SQLite storage, delivery/reconnect/projection/idempotency fixes, conflict resolution, and real paired-node proof before reconsidering the branch.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product/security architecture choice over gateway-node runtime ownership, and steipete has recent node invoke/security history plus PR routing signal.
